scope: Focused CPU construction, expanded-instance triangle budgets and idempotent resource ownership; Canvas drawing stubbed, no browser or GPU
command: npx vitest run tests/gp-chain-drive.test.ts tests/motogp-reference.test.ts tests/bike-bodies.test.ts

final_frozen_source.sourceHashEncoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON (separators comma/colon), with lexicographically sorted path keys; values are file SHA-256 digests.

limits: The CPU witness counts the entire constructed high-detail model with each instance expanded; it is not the GP41 scene render count.
The lifecycle witness proves disposal-event ownership and idempotence. It does not measure process memory or attribute any previous browser crash.
